critical_code_review_comments: client_import.py:_classify_user_stage — the password_changed branch is convoluted: outer if `engagement.password_changed_at OR not user.must_change_password` is followed by an INNER if `user.is_reactivated AND (engagement.password_changed_at OR user.password_changed_at)` that ONLY then returns 'password_changed'. If the outer is True but the inner is False (e.g. a non-reactivated user who has must_change_password=False from registration), the function falls through to first_login_at → returns 'logged_in'. That's the intended behaviour for organic users (only imported clients should reach the password_changed bucket), but the dual-condition is brittle — recommend simplifying to a single explicit check `is_reactivated and (engagement.password_changed_at or password_changed_at)` for clarity.

_segment_match_fragment uses `{'$in': [None, '', False]}` for not-set checks; this works but `{'$nin': [None, '', False]}` for opposite side (opened_no_login) does NOT match documents where the field is absent. Mongo treats missing as null so both conditions are equivalent here, but a $exists guard would be more explicit. Verified runtime behaviour is correct (counts add up to total emailed).

resend-campaign loads up to 5000 targets in memory and fires emails sequentially in the request handler. For a list of 5k legacy clients this can block the HTTP worker for several seconds even with fire-and-forget send_email_background. Consider chunking or a true background task (e.g. asyncio.create_task) for production scale.

AdminClientImportAnalyticsPage.jsx — campaign-launch-modal closes via setTimeout-then-reload pattern; works but the post-send reload re-fetches funnel+segments+campaigns separately. Could batch into a single Promise.all to reduce flicker. Cosmetic.

Funnel and segment endpoints both fetch users.find() with the same filter; for very large datasets a $facet aggregation pipeline returning funnel+segment-counts in one round-trip would be cheaper. OK at current scale (20 users) but flag for scale.
/admin/client-import/campaigns has no pagination cursor (just limit). Fine for now (max 200) but campaigns will accrue over time.
